steps.action: create schedule on existing subscription and replace with zero then paid phase
finalize only bound held draft with auto_advance=false, then void

meaning: A provider collection hold prevents renewal charging during checkout/unknown recovery. Scheduling preserves the hold. The exact held renewal is finalized without auto-collection then voided before collection resumes; the next paid invoice occurs only at the extended expiry.
limitations: No Mangmee application repurchase orchestration/grant proof yet.
Already-created invoices are not stopped by pause_collection. Must inspect existing collectible invoices both before and after the hold and refuse a new Checkout if any raced.
Only strictly bound draft invoices generated by this hold can be compensated; unrelated or paid invoices require operator review.
Abandoned/expired Checkout must restore existing renewal collection, including exact held drafts, through durable recovery.
Hold is not an access entitlement; CompanyPlanTerm/paid ledger remain authoritative.
